_comment: Solo stratum for GPUs and CPU miners. Same payout rule as solo-asic.json (97.5% to the miner, 2.5% fee), with the low starting difficulty a non-ASIC needs. Its own solo_data_dir: two instances must not write the same book file.
_vardiff_comment: A 500 MH/s GPU wants difficulty 1 (500e6 * 4s / 2^32 = 0.47), and a 2 GH/s card only wants 2, so the floor and the start are both 1 as on the pooled GPU port (:3333). The cap matches the ASIC port so an ASIC that lands here still settles at a sane share rate instead of climbing to the 2^40 exponent limit.
